h1: Revelstoke ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Revelstoke has 1,713 metres of vertical, which the resort states is the greatest in North America, served by four lifts over 3,121 acres. The Last Spike runs 15.2 kilometres from Sub Peak to a village at 512 metres, and the mountain takes 10.5 metres of snow in an average year.
stayOverview: The resort village sits at the gondola base at 512 metres - the lowest base of any resort in this project - and the railway town of Revelstoke is below it.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The resort village is ski-in; the town has the restaurants and the cheaper beds.
rentalCars: Revelstoke is on the Trans-Canada Highway between Calgary and Kelowna, and a car is the normal way to arrive.
